The '''Capture of the ''Link''''' was a battle fought during the [[Zaarin insurrection]].

==Prelude==
The commander of the ''Victory''-class Star Destroyer ''Zeplin'', [[Namuura Din]], expressing sympathy for the Rebel Alliance's cause, decided to defect from the Zaarin government faction of the Galactic Empire as well as the Galactic Empire itself to the Rebel Alliance. To prove himself to the Rebel's [[MC80 Star Cruiser/Legends|MC80 Star Cruiser]], the ''Link'', he supplied them with information detailing that the lead to the Death Star II at Endor was a trap devised by Emperor Palpatine, as well as the Missile Boat prototype, the ''[[Sealion]]'' just as the Imperials located and captured him and his ship. The ''Link'' managed to escape with both the knowledge on Endor and the ''Sealion'', which Din admitted when Vader interrogated him. This led to the capture of the ''Link'' to be top priority. Tau Squadron, led by Maarek Stele, was to be deployed to bombard the ''Link''{{'s}} shields to 0%, and then allow Mu Squadron to move in and disable it, and then allow ''Omega 1'' to board the ship and capture it, with Alpha Squadron providing starfighter backup.

==The Battle==
As soon as Stele was launched from the hanger there were [[Z-95 Headhunter/Legends|Z-95 Headhunters]] right behind him, he ignored them and went towards the Link, as soon as he could but the ''[[Sealion]]'' managed to jump to [[Hyperspace/Legends|Hyperspace]] which the [[Garrett (Star Destroyer)|''Garrett'']] soon jumped to pursue.

Stele destroyed the [[Delta-class DX-9 stormtrooper transport|transport]] ''[[Fetch]]'' which carried [[Fuel Rod]]s from the [[Class-C cargo container|Class-C]] [[Cargo container/Legends|container]] which was also destroyed, preventing what was suspected which was an engine overload. With the [[Immobilizer 418 Interdictor-class Heavy Cruiser|Immobilizer 418 cruiser]] ''[[Bew'a]]'' keeping the ''Link'' from going anywhere, Stele then engaged multiple Z-95s, [[T-65 X-wing starfighter/Legends|X-wings]], [[RZ-1 A-wing interceptor/Legends|A-wings]], [[R60 T-wing interceptor|T-wings]] and [[R-41 Starchaser]]s. With the fighters dwindling and the cruiser's shields failing, the [[CR92a Assassin-class corvette|modified corvette]] ''[[Crater]]'' arrived to try to reinforce the ''Link'', followed by [[A/SF-01 B-wing starfighter/Legends|B-wings]] to attack the [[Gamma-class ATR-6 assault transport|assault transport]] ''[[Omega 1]]'' soon afterwards followed by [[Muurian transport]] ''[[Confal]]'' to provide transport support. All the reinforcements were destroyed and ''Omega 1'' boarded the ''Link'' and after capturing the Cruiser, the ''Garrett'' arrived to deploy two more transports to the ''Link'' as two [[BTL Y-wing starfighter/Legends|Y-wings]] launched from the cruiser, followed by A-wings which were easily eliminated. Soon a [[Nebulon-B2 frigate]] ''[[Qork]]'', followed by an [[Ton-Falk-class escort carrier]] ''[[Mist]]'' arrived to resupply the ''Garrett'' as a final wave of B-wings attacked the ships only to be destroyed.

==Aftermath==
The ''Link'' was captured, but the ''Sealion'' was sent to a Rebel Base to be reverse-engineered, requiring the Imperials to pursue it and either recover or otherwise destroy the ''Sealion''.

Meanwhile, Emperor Palpatine summoned Grand Admiral Thrawn to his throne room. He told Thrawn that all preparations were ready for the final attack at Endor, and that the Rebels will soon see the futility of their resistance against his rule. He then demanded that Thrawn bring the hunt for Zaarin down to its final conclusion, and that he not fail him. Thrawn then informed him that he has studied Zaarin's ways closely and came up with a solution to the conflict, one that will ensure that Zaarin fall into a trap that will result in his death. Palpatine then expressed satisfaction with Thrawn's progress, and declared that with Zaarin and the Rebel Alliance soon out of the picture, the Galactic Empire's victory will be completed.

==Behind the scenes==
This battle appears in the [[1994]] PC game ''Star Wars: TIE Fighter'' on Battle 13 Combat 3. This article assumes "medium" difficulty, while on "hard" difficulty, oddly enough, R-41 Starchasers and T-wings do not appear.
